# Vectors: payload-guideline

Guideline baseline: `2f00e9f` · Kind: payload · 20 vectors · [All vector files](README.md)

Golden payload vectors taken from Appendix B (MG B1.1.2, B1.1.5, B1.1.11, B1.1.12, B1.2.1): topic and message of the Message Bus; and the predefined MetaData of the Alliance resources (MG B2.1 … B2.8) as bare DataSetMetaDataType objects. The reference checks cover the envelope of MG 8 (areas MSG and ACT); the DataSet content of the resources is checked from C-026/C-027 on.
